# omics-skills 2.0.0

Version 2.0.0 cuts the pack from 27 skills to 12 and from three agents to one, and removes the
keyword router. Current models pick a skill from its description and know the standard tools, so
the pack now holds what a model cannot derive: house rules, the owner's own tools, a hosted
literature corpus, and small tested helpers. This release removes skills, scripts and Makefile
targets; read "Upgrade from 1.x" before you update.

## Skills

Twelve skills remain: `omics-pipeline`, `bioinformatics-project`, `polars-dovmed`,
`crossref-lookup`, `public-db-lookup`, `beautiful-data-viz`, `notebooks`, `bio-logic`, and the
stage skills `tracking-taxonomy-updates`, `bio-annotation`, `bio-viromics` and
`bio-interdomain-hgt`.

**Folded into `omics-pipeline`.** Six stage skills are now one decision page each under
`skills/omics-pipeline/references/`: reads QC and mapping, assembly, binning, gene calling,
phylogenomics and structure. A page gives the default tool per case, the rules a model would not
guess, command lines, and the QC gates to record. Tool notes stay only for tools that models
know poorly: QuickBin, Autocycler, pyrodigal-gv, Infernal with its Rfam model table, Boltz and
the pinned TM-Vec fork. The drivers, fixtures and general tool manuals of these six stages are
gone; a project writes its own restartable driver as `bioinformatics-project` describes.

**Removed.** `exploratory-data-analysis`, `bio-workflow-methods-docwriter`,
`bio-foundation-housekeeping`, `bio-stats-ml-reporting`, `bio-protein-clustering-pangenome`,
`bio-fasta-database-curator` and `preprint-search`.

**Moved out of the pack.** `proposal-review` and `ai-scientist-evaluator` are review tools, not
omics skills, and are now maintained outside this repository.

**Slimmed.** `bio-logic` keeps the hypothesis register, the reflection format and the
claim-against-evidence check, without its textbook reference pages. `notebooks` drops four
copied marimo documents. `bio-annotation` and `bio-viromics` drop the general manuals for
DIAMOND, eggNOG-mapper, InterProScan, TaxonKit, geNomad and CheckV and keep one decision page
each.

## Agents

`literature-expert` remains. `omics-scientist` and `science-writer` are removed; the discovery
and reporting rules of `omics-scientist` are now rules 8 and 9 of `omics-pipeline`.

## Router, catalog and hint hook

`scripts/skill_index.py`, the generated `catalog/catalog.json`, the routing benchmark and its
baseline, and the per-prompt routing hint hook are removed, with the Makefile targets
`build-catalog`, `install-catalog`, `install-hook`, `uninstall-hook`, `hook-status` and
`benchmark`. In 90 days of session logs the router was consulted in fewer than one in ten of the
sessions that used a pack skill, and it recommended a skill for prompts such as "how do I rename
a git branch". `make test` now runs the three validators and the unit tests.

The installer keeps `install`, `install-claude`, `install-codex`, `install-selected`,
`uninstall`, `status`, `validate` and `clean`. A skill selection (`SELECTED_SKILL_DIRS`) installs
exactly the selection with every install target; a selection that holds `omics-pipeline` or a
stage skill gets the whole stage group, and the installer prints what it added. An install
removes a link to a retired skill or agent only when the link points into this checkout. It no
longer archives copied skill directories or rendered Codex agents. A directory under `skills/`
without a `SKILL.md`, such as one that only ignored `__pycache__` files keep alive after the
update, is skipped.

## Other changes since 1.7.1

Version 1.8.0 was never tagged; its changes ship here:

- `beautiful-data-viz` makes greyscale the default for every figure and uses color only to
  encode information.
- A version in a skill records what its commands were checked against. It is not an install
  pin: a project takes the newest release at setup and locks it. No skill, script or example
  holds a real email address, and a test fails on one.
- `bioinformatics-project` uses pixi instead of conda, works on `main`, commits
  `tasks/METHODS.md`, and submits Slurm drivers from the project root.
- `polars-dovmed` helpers run from the installed skill directory.
- The installer renders and installs agents idempotently, and `LINK_CLIENT_SKILLS=no` leaves
  `~/.claude/skills` and `~/.codex/skills` to another tool.
- The docs site has seven pages instead of fifteen.

## Fixes since 1.7.1

A full audit preceded the restructure. The fixes that remain relevant after it:

- `bio-annotation`, `bio-viromics` and `bio-interdomain-hgt`: a failed driver run left partial
  output, so the rerun stopped on "output directory is not empty". Validation now runs before
  the first write, and a table row with the wrong field count is rejected on read.
- `bio-interdomain-hgt`: tree support on a percent scale passed the 0.9 gate, and domain labels
  outside the vocabulary were accepted.
- `tracking-taxonomy-updates`: `Bacteriophage` routed to GTDB-Tk, and the EukCC job skipped
  bins that do not end in `.fa` (new variable `EUKCC_SUFFIX`).
- `polars-dovmed`: the helper refused to run without an API key although the hosted API is
  public.
- `public-db-lookup`: MGnify moved to API v2; esearch reports the hit count; text without a
  charset is decoded as UTF-8; URL-encoded keys and addresses are redacted from error messages.
- `crossref-lookup`: the bibliography audit counted `booktitle` fields as missing DOIs.
- `beautiful-data-viz`: slides fonts were smaller than notebook fonts when seaborn was
  installed, and `finalize_axes` raised a warning under `constrained_layout`.
- `notebooks`: `execute_notebook.py` failed without `--kernel` and kept the kernel placeholder.
- `bioinformatics-project`: `--check` failed once a scaffolded file was edited.
- `scripts/validate-citations.py`: a citation that names an author or year now fails when its
  cache record holds neither.

## Upgrade from 1.x

1. If you installed the routing hint hook, run `make uninstall-hook` in the 1.x checkout before
   you update. Version 2.0.0 has no such target, and a hook that stays installed calls a script
   that no longer exists.
2. Update the checkout and run `make install`. Links to removed skills and agents that point
   into the checkout are removed, and so are the router files under `~/.agents/omics-skills/`.
3. Delete by hand what the installer cannot attribute to this pack: the rendered Codex agents
   `~/.codex/agents/omics-scientist.toml` and `~/.codex/agents/science-writer.toml`, and, after
   a copy install, the directories of removed skills under `~/.agents/skills/`.
4. Scripts that projects called by path are gone with their skills, among them
   `run_reads_qc_mapping.py`, `run_assembly_qc.py`, `run_gene_calling.py`,
   `run_phylogenomics.py`, `run_structure_annotation.py`, `build_bin_qc_tables.py`,
   `build_pangenome_artifacts.py`, `curate_fasta.py`, `eda_analyzer.py` and the workflow-run
   extractors. Check out tag `v1.7.1` to copy a script into a project that still needs it.
   The 1.7.1 copies do not contain the fixes made after that tag.

## Validation

The truth-set registry under `validation/` now lists the three remaining drivers (annotation,
viromics, interdomain HGT). All three truth sets are candidates; no validation job is defined.
